text: The trust and animacy of the agent as perceived by the test subjects (Sub-RQ1.1) will be measured using the AIrepresentation scale [10]. The performance of the participants in the tests (e.g. percentage of correct answers,efficiency) are then compared to subjective answers and combined to answer Sub-RQ1.2. In combination bothresults are expected to clearly outline the effects of 3D parasocial interaction on the participants (RQ1).In addition, the five-point Human-Computer Trust Scale proposed by Madsen and Gregor [4] will be used tomeasure and quantify the sense of trust perceived by test prospects (RQ2). Acceptance will be evaluated withthe Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology [11] (RQ2).
